hadith_en: Narrated `Urwahibn al-Ja’d (may Allah be pleased with him): The Prophetﷺsaid, "Goodnessremains in the foreheads of horses till the Day of Resurrection, for they bring about either a reward or booty.”.
syarah_en: Fighting in the way of Allah is the noblest of deeds and is indeed the pinnacle of Islam for which life and wealth are sacrificed. Allah has made horses a symbol of power and strength in battles and wars, and whoever prepares them well for such purposes will surely attain abundant goodness in this life and the Hereafter.In this hadeeth, the Prophet ﷺ explains that goodness is permanently connectedto horses, just like forelockis attached to their foreheads. The reward mentioned in the hadeeth refers to the reward of Allah in the Hereafter, and the booty refers to the booty of wars in this worldly life. The horses mentioned in the hadeeth refer to the horses allocated by their owners for use in war.This hadeeth shows that fighting in the way of Allah will never cease to exist, and it encourages us in using horses for Jihaad..
